name: Philips 75PUS8505
summary: Philips 75PUS8505 ships with TP Vision telemetry, promos and a retail demo. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This 75 inch Philips set from 2020 runs Android TV 12 and ships with TP Vision telemetry, Philips content promos and an app gallery, a retail demo and Google first-setup leftovers. The list also covers voice assistants and Play-Fi speaker apps this owner does not use.

Every entry was checked on this TV before it went on the list. The set has little memory, and its home screen can be replaced by a lighter one. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Sources drawer service, which breaks if it is switched off
The DLNA media player, which the Media app uses
notes: The very first start of a new home screen can be slow on this set. Give it a minute before trying again.
The Sources drawer stops working if its service is switched off. TidyTV keeps it on.
Netflix, Prime Video and Freeview apps are already off from the factory on a Czech unit.

faq.q: Will the Sources button still work?
faq.a: Yes. The service behind the Sources drawer is kept, because the drawer stops working without it.

faq.q: Do I need to keep Play-Fi apps?
faq.a: The list switches off one Play-Fi part, the speaker setup helper. If you use DTS Play-Fi wireless speakers, switch it back on in the app.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
